title: Deferred: SmsBower exact_reuse
description: SmsBower exact_reuse path deferred until sufficient API evidence is gathered. SmsBower stays at SameActivationRetry only. -- Chosen to defer: no documented endpoint for exact number reuse in SmsBower API.

title: Deferred: Pool ranking / cost heuristics
description: No priority ordering within pool candidates for now. First-match is sufficient. -- Chosen to defer: premature optimization without usage data.

title: Deferred: Cross-provider reuse
description: A number from provider A is never offered to provider B. Pool is provider-scoped. -- Chosen to defer: no use case identified and would violate provider isolation.

title: Deferred: UI visibility of pool state
description: UI display of reuse pool candidates, hit rates, and eviction events. -- Chosen to defer: Phase 3 (Operator Closure) concern.

title: Deferred: Full pool entry detail view
description: Raw pool entries with phone numbers and expiry for advanced debugging. -- Chosen to defer: summary-level visibility sufficient for v1; raw phone exposure is security concern.

title: Deferred: Reuse success/failure metrics dashboard
description: Aggregate hit rate, miss rate, eviction rate metrics. -- Chosen to defer: future observability phase.

title: Deferred: Automated visual regression tests
description: No visual test framework exists. Manual checklist for now. -- Chosen to defer: tooling investment not justified for current scope.

title: Deferred: intent_reuse vs exact_reuse UI distinction
description: Both show as Reused badge in v1. Backend-internal distinction not surfaced to operator. -- Chosen to defer: operator feedback needed to justify added complexity.
